summary: Executed real Supabase + Next wrapper backend regression tests and UI integration smoke for inventory synchronization and checkout.

critical.issue: Order placement fails with SQL error: column reference "m.id" is ambiguous, breaking all successful future reservations/checkout flows.

minor.issue: First `yarn build` run failed with `Unexpected end of JSON input`; second run after clearing `.next` succeeded (flaky build behavior).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking `Block date` does not create a blocked day, and no success/error feedback is shown.
Sign Out button has no click handler (no logout action).

integration_issues.issue: Checkout remains on payment with error (good failure handling), but error shown is raw SQL internal message from backend.
Admin menu stock toggle synchronized to customer menu in separate tab (verified).

issues: No horizontal overflow observed at 320/768/1024/1440 during tested flow.

action_items: Fix SQL in `place_inventory_order` function (ambiguous `m.id` reference) and retest all order/atomic/idempotency flows.
Fix `Block date` UI flow so submit persists blocked_dates and surfaces success/error status.
Map backend SQL errors to user-safe error messages (avoid leaking internal SQL text).
Wire actual sign-out action in AdminLayout button.
Add missing `data-testid` attributes to login form controls for maintainable automation.
critical_code_review_comments: `place_inventory_order` uses PL/pgSQL record variable `m` and SQL alias `m` in same scope; this causes runtime ambiguity and blocks the primary reservation workflow.
Admin blocking UX has no observable state transition or error handling feedback on submit, causing silent failure behavior.
Raw backend exception messages are directly rendered in checkout error banner (security/UX concern).

success_rate.frontend: 60% (core smoke and checkout failure behavior verified; block-date UI flow failing)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated QA menu items with `qa-inventory-*` prefix via automated tests; fixture items were cleaned up. QA orders created for verification remain as historical records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary blocker is backend `place_inventory_order` SQL ambiguity. Re-run `/app/tests/test_inventory_core.py` after fix. UI block-date issue reproduced repeatedly from admin availability page; backend RPC `set_blocked_date` works via API tests, so likely frontend submission/state issue.
rca of the issue: RCA: `place_inventory_order` fails at runtime with Postgres 42702 due to ambiguous `m.id` reference (PL/pgSQL variable/table alias collision). Reproduction: any valid checkout payload to RPC or /api/orders. Impact: future guest checkout, atomic race tests, idempotency success path, and order snapshot cascade verification all fail because no order can be placed through inventory RPC. Mitigation: rename SQL alias/PLpgSQL variable and retest reservation + idempotency + rollback suite. Separately, admin block-date UI submit appears to no-op despite no visible errors; investigate BlockedDays submit path/state binding and response handling.
